intro: Fiery Broccoli is a bold topping option on the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) that brings heat and flavor to any bowl or pita. This charred broccoli tossed in chili oil delivers a spicy kick while adding nutritious vegetables to your meal. At just 35 calories, it is a complimentary topping that enhances your [full CAVA menu](/menu) customization experience.
priceCalories: Fiery Broccoli is included free with any CAVA order, making it an excellent value addition. At only 35 calories per serving, this spicy topping adds bold flavor without significantly impacting your meal total. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how it fits into your personalized bowl or pita nutritional goals.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Fiery Broccoli apart is the perfect balance of char and spice. The broccoli is fire-roasted to create a smoky, caramelized exterior, then tossed in premium chili oil for heat. This preparation method adds depth and complexity that elevates it beyond standard steamed vegetables. The combination creates a crunchy, flavorful topping that transforms ordinary meals.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Fiery Broccoli contains 35 calories with 1g protein, 2g carbohydrates, and 2.5g fat. The minimal calorie count makes it ideal for those watching their intake while the protein and fiber from broccoli support satiety. The fat content comes from heart-healthy chili oil. Use the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for complete nutritional planning.
whatsInside: This spicy topping features premium broccoli florets that are fire-roasted until charred and crispy. The chili oil coating provides a complex heat with aromatic undertones. The simple ingredient list ensures a clean, wholesome addition to your meal. For specific dietary needs or allergies, reference the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) before ordering.
tasteLike: Fiery Broccoli delivers a smoky, spicy flavor profile with a satisfying crunch. The char adds a slight bitterness that balances the heat from the chili oil, while the broccoli maintains its natural earthiness. The spice level is noticeable but not overwhelming, creating a warming sensation. The texture contrasts beautifully with creamy dips and tender proteins throughout the menu.
customize: Add Fiery Broccoli to any creation from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or build your own masterpiece. It pairs exceptionally well with cooling ingredients like Tzatziki or Hummus from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads). Layer it with Shredded Romaine and Sumac Cabbage Slaw for textural variety, or combine with milder toppings to balance the heat.
pairsWell: Fiery Broccoli complements grilled chicken, lamb, or falafel from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) perfectly. Pair it with cooling options like Shredded Romaine, Tomato + Onion, and cucumber to balance the spice. Creamy dressings like Yogurt Dill or Tahini from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) help temper the heat while adding richness to your bowl.
healthyChoice: With only 35 calories and 1g of protein, Fiery Broccoli is an excellent healthy choice. Broccoli provides essential vitamins, minerals, and fiber that support digestive health and immunity. The chili oil contains capsaicin, which may boost metabolism. This topping adds substantial nutrition without excess calories, making it perfect for health-conscious diners exploring the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free).
howToOrder: Order Fiery Broccoli at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by requesting it as a topping when building your bowl or pita. It is automatically included at no extra charge. Simply tell the team member you want Fiery Broccoli added, and specify the amount you prefer. You can also add it when ordering online or through the CAVA app.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Shredded Romaine at 5 calories or Tomato + Onion at 20 calories, Fiery Broccoli offers more bold flavor at 35 calories. While Sumac Cabbage Slaw provides tanginess at 30 calories, Fiery Broccoli delivers heat and smokiness. Unlike Pita Crisps at 70 calories, this option provides vegetables with fewer calories while adding spice instead of crunch.
whoShouldTry: Spice lovers and adventurous eaters will enjoy Fiery Broccoli. Those seeking low-calorie flavor boosters should definitely try it. Vegetable enthusiasts looking to add variety beyond standard greens will appreciate the unique preparation. Anyone building a customized bowl or exploring the diverse [full CAVA menu](/menu) should experience this bold topping at least once.
worthTrying: Fiery Broccoli is absolutely worth trying for anyone who enjoys spicy food or wants to elevate their CAVA experience. The complimentary price point means no financial risk, while the low calorie count makes it diet-friendly. The unique charred preparation and chili oil coating create a restaurant-quality topping that adds excitement to any meal without extra cost.

faqs.q: How many calories are in Fiery Broccoli?
faqs.a: Fiery Broccoli contains 35 calories per serving, making it a low-calorie topping option that adds bold flavor to your CAVA bowl or pita without significantly increasing your meal total.

faqs.q: Is Fiery Broccoli included free at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, Fiery Broccoli is a complimentary topping included with your meal at no additional charge. You can add as much or as little as you like when customizing your bowl or pita.
The spiciness comes from the chili oil that coats the charred broccoli. The heat level is moderate and adds a warming kick without being overwhelmingly hot for most diners.
Yes, Fiery Broccoli is gluten-free as it contains only charred broccoli and chili oil. For complete allergen information, check the CAVA Allergen Menu or ask team members at your location.

faqs.q: Can I add Fiery Broccoli to any CAVA order?
faqs.a: Yes, you can add Fiery Broccoli to any bowl, pita, or salad when building your meal. It works well with all protein options and complements both the Curated Bowls and custom creations.
